resource_authorization: User preference: reduce previous 30 GiB reserve; retain 16 GiB per domain
feature_space: expert/history inputs only; no GRAM-state input
gate_scope: one beta/alpha per current user context shared by all items and generation prefixes
guide_scope: existing conditional expert mass at EVERY generation prefix
loss: full catalog expert CE parent, then mean length-normalized target-path NLL
epoch_selection: same user-hash80/20; CE and NLL checkpoints0/4/8/12/20; refit all ranker_fit
parent_initialization: same retained input columns; replaced mass columns use old Top5 initialization
old_parent: reuse verified 21.40 pruned7 full and fit-only CE parents; refit NLL
stop_after: four arms x two development512 pools, seed0; no automatic follow-up
filtered_mass: sum softmax(20 * expert score) on filtered history, separately per expert
architecture: all active inputs through shared32 ReLU; beta32to2 and alpha32to1
factorial_axes: retain vs delete two top1-top2 gaps
